blockers: No HF trainable Saluki weights in fixed official revision: seven files inspected, GGUF/projectors/docs only.
Installed GGUF Qwen3.5 CUDA backward support not verified; installed quantizer declares is_trainable=False.
Existing root free space does not fit dense equivalent plus 3GiB reserve; shared filesystem df does not establish tenant quota.
27B training peak memory not measured on approved 16GB GPUs; no fit guarantee from nominal 4-bit size.

proposed_recipe_unexecuted.representation: Exact Saluki HF weights if publisher provides them, or exact GGUF conversion/packed training only after lineage and CUDA backward validation
proposed_recipe_unexecuted.method: QLoRA NF4 double quantization when exact HF representation is available; never rename Qwen base or different Underdog as Saluki

baseline.target_modules: Resolved language-only attention/linear-attention/MLP linear layers; exact list recorded before smoke; freeze vision, embeddings and output head
baseline.overlength_policy: fail preflight, never silently drop or cut itinerary/question

verify: peak CUDA allocated/reserved and cgroup RAM
reserve at least 1GiB VRAM and 3GiB disk

data.review_scope: Additional H-train900 are AI agreed; do not extend that claim to every base1713 row. Completion contract checked2613/2613.
data.sampling: Use all fixed2613 rows with original normal/NONE distribution; ordinary seeded shuffle only, no reweighting/resampling
data.source_overlap_filter: Existing builder excludes H-test/D2/D3 3gramJaccard>=0.6;99 candidates excluded; does not prove final semantic independence

ablations: One first baseline: reviewed train_oos2 2613 unchanged, cosine rank8
Only after first baseline: additional seeds/methods if evidence justifies them; no mandatory1713 baseline
Product adoption separate: independent reviewed holdout and regressions

decision_gates.paired_fp_improvement: two-sided exact paired test, multiplicity and uncertainty stated
decision_gates.normal_preservation: confidence interval lower bound for paired accuracy difference >= -1pp; descriptive count alone is not pass
decision_gates.holdout: independent fixed positive240/negative480 minimum target, person review pending
decision_gates.regressions: D/D2/D3/H/E plus new selection-and-evidence-answer contract; every failure/incomplete remains in denominator

conditional_backlog.order: Use available approved GPU after existing queue work; do not block ready jobs behind this preparation item
resume: Recheck same Saluki trainable representation, CUDA backward and actual existing quota/memory
Use already frozen reviewed train_oos2 2613 without creating new data; verify identity/token lengths
Acquire existing exclusive queue lock and perform16-example GPU smoke
After smoke register one baseline run with new adapter output
Compare original and baseline normal requests/NONE simultaneously on fixed development tests; independent human-reviewed holdout needed only before product adoption

limitations: Nominal 4bit 27B=13.5GB is a lower-bound estimate excluding embeddings, metadata, adapters, gradients and activations, not observed training memory.
55.56GB Qwen HF size is a base-model storage reference, not an identical Saluki checkpoint.
Exact overlap zero does not prove semantic or itinerary-family independence.
Model card and paper scores are external results, never our measured improvement.
user_steering: Use existing reviewed travel training set directly for the first correction baseline. Do not wait for new pairs/F/final holdout.

gate_stages.smoke: Same model/lineage, CUDA backward, existing train data audit, local weights, space and exclusive lock; no new pairs/F/independent holdout prerequisite
gate_stages.baseline: Smoke prerequisites plus successful GPU smoke; no independent final holdout prerequisite
gate_stages.adoption: Baseline plus frozen independent holdout, final evaluation and normal/NONE regression checks
